instruments.notes: Year-end 1996 open natural gas hedges covering approx. 21 percent of estimated 1997 average daily gas production at an average price of $2.20 per MMBTU; hedge type not specified (policy lists fixed price hedges, costless collars, other). Volume not stated.
instruments.evidence_quote:
At December 31, 1996, the Company was a party to natural gas hedging
contracts to hedge approximately 21 percent of its estimated 1997 average daily
natural gas production at an average price per MMBTU of $2.20.

instruments.notes: NGM (gas marketing subsidiary) hedges of third-party purchases/sales, in place at 12/31/1996, ranging from approximately 7,475 to 551,126 MMBTU per day for future physical transactions; range only, no single daily volume stated.

At December 31, 1996, NGM had in place hedges ranging from approximately

for future physical transactions.

hedging_summary.stated_hedging_policy: From time to time uses fixed price hedges, costless collars and other arrangements on anticipated oil and gas production to minimize price fluctuation impact; NGM hedges third-party gas purchases/sales.
